title: Premarital Money Talks Workbook, Engaged Couples Finance Questions Before Marriage, Fillable PDF Printable, Wedding Budget Money Agreement
description:
Most premarital workbooks give money one page. This one is all about money: six short talks couples often skip before the wedding, ending in a one-page Money Agreement you both sign.

Answer on your own first (Partner A, Partner B), then fill in the "together" part. One page per step, about 30 to 45 minutes a talk.

See more of our Couples Finance tools here: https://www.etsy.com/shop/WayofWealthStudio?section_id=57077407
See the rest of our shop here: https://www.etsy.com/shop/WayofWealthStudio
Go deeper with our Couples Money Mindset Workbook: https://www.etsy.com/listing/4461192508
Pair it with our Couples Money Conversation Starter: https://www.etsy.com/listing/4478858153

WHAT'S INSIDE (18 pages)
- How-to page and a six-talk plan
- Money stories, income, savings and everything you each owe
- Joint, separate or hybrid accounts, plus a fair-split worksheet (50/50 or by income)
- Wedding budget and who pays
- Children, career breaks, family support, home, retirement
- Money Agreement, 12-month money date tracker, 20 quick questions

DETAILS
- Fillable PDF (laptop, tablet or phone) plus print versions
- A4 and US Letter, any currency
- README with how-to steps
- Instant download, nothing is posted
- Questions: joel@wayofwealthcoaching.com

Made by Joel (MSc Behavioural Economics). Photos show the real pages; the desk background in photo 1 was made with AI. General information, not financial or legal advice.
